# Support

Start with the [documentation](../docs/index.md) and
[troubleshooting guide](../docs/guides/troubleshooting.md).

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Reproducible Hub bug | [GitHub issue](https://github.com/magrathean-uk/teslatlas-hub/issues/new?template=bug_report.md) |
| Incorrect or unclear documentation | [Documentation issue](https://github.com/magrathean-uk/teslatlas-hub/issues/new?template=documentation.md) |
| Security vulnerability | [Private security report](SECURITY.md) |
| Tesla account, vehicle or provider-service fault | The relevant provider's support route |
| Legal notice | Email `contact@magrathean.uk` with subject `LEGAL NOTICE` |

Only platforms and versions named by a tagged release are supported. Include
the exact Hub version, platform, topology, reproduction steps, expected result,
actual result and redacted diagnostics. Do not post tokens, VINs, coordinates,
private logs or production data.

Teslatlas Hub is provided without a support commitment or warranty under the
GNU AGPL. Paid support, hosting, service levels or support for modified builds
requires a separate written agreement with MAGRATHEAN UK LTD. A fork must not
present itself as an official or supported Magrathean release.
